faqs.a:
(a)
Appointment.
The city council shall appoint a presiding municipal court judge who shall be compensated
               pursuant to an employment agreement, and who shall report directly to city council.
               Pursuant to the city charter, the presiding municipal court judge shall be a resident
               of the city.
(b)
Supervisory duties.
The city council hereby designates the court administrator as the clerk of the municipal
               court. The court administrator shall report directly to the presiding municipal court
               judge.
(Code 1981, § 18-41; Ord. No. 3676, § 1, 1-22-2001; Ord. No.
